summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly ADS buyback activity under a program announced October 30, 2025, with a discretionary mandate to repurchase up to EUR 30 million. During July 13–17, 2026, the company bought 51,168 shares at an average price of EUR 5.84, totaling EUR 299,057. Since program launch on January 26, 2026, the company has repurchased 1,157,574 shares (2.0% of outstanding) for EUR 5.73 million. This is an ongoing open-market buyback reducing share count and returning cash to shareholders. Watch for program completion timeline and impact on share price support.
